name: Journey to Sentinel Hill

angles.text: Westfall needs help, but Stormwind has left its commanders waiting for soldiers. They rely on whatever volunteers arrive.
At Sentinel Hill, the frontier commander may grumble that Stormwind sent a skinny elf instead of seasoned infantry. The outpost needs all the help it can get.

aliases: what is journey to sentinel hill
faq.answer: Journey to Sentinel Hill brings Alliance travelers into Westfall, where defenders at Sentinel Hill have asked Stormwind for help without receiving enough soldiers.
faq.q: What is Journey to Sentinel Hill?

aliases: who is begging stormwind for aid
faq.answer: Sentinel Hill’s leaders have asked Stormwind for soldiers for months to meet the troubles in Westfall. With no reinforcements, they rely on whichever travelers arrive.
faq.q: Why is Sentinel Hill asking for help?

faq.answer: The commander expected help from Stormwind after months of pleas, but got a skinny elf instead. Beggars cannot be choosers, so the commander puts the newcomer to work.
faq.q: Why does the quest text mention a skinny elf?

faq.answer: Sentinel Hill has appealed to Stormwind for months, but royal support has not arrived. The local commanders depend on volunteers.
faq.q: Why hasn't Stormwind sent proper reinforcements?

faq.answer: Sentinel Hill is a military outpost guarding Westfall’s farmlands. It is the main defense against the region’s lawlessness, Defias bandits, and gnolls.

aliases: what happens after arriving in westfall
faq.answer: When you report to Sentinel Hill, the local defenders put you to work at once. You help face the many threats across Westfall’s plains and farmlands.
faq.q: What happens after reaching Sentinel Hill?

sections.body: In Westfall, you arrive at Sentinel Hill, the outpost guarding the surrounding farmlands. Its garrison is short of soldiers and overlooked by the royal court. When travelers offer help, the local commander asks little about their standing. Any willing hands are welcome.
sections.title: Arrival on the Frontier

sections.body: For months, Sentinel Hill’s leaders have asked Stormwind for soldiers to defend Westfall from threats drawing near. With no reinforcements, local commanders accept whoever arrives. One commander expected an army and got a skinny elf instead. In Westfall, beggars cannot be choosers.
sections.title: Pleas to Stormwind

summary: At Sentinel Hill, Journey to Sentinel Hill brings Alliance travelers into Westfall’s troubled farmlands. The local commanders have pleaded with Stormwind for months without answer, and now put any willing traveler to work.
attribution: In-game quest text: Journey to Sentinel Hill
